Acknowledge a comment mutation (edit, delete, or post) on a work object entity. Apps call this endpoint to confirm they have processed a comment action, and the backend emits a dedicated RTM event to the user.

Rate limit tier: 3

Method-specific errors (the `error` slug on the SlackError):
  - `method_not_found` — when the API isn't available to the caller
  - `invalid_trigger_id` — Trigger id is not valid
  - `invalid_app_id` — App ID is not a valid format
  - `invalid_auth` — Invalid token provided
  - `invalid_action` — The comment data does not match the original trigger context (e.g., comment_id or thread_root_id mismatch)
  - `missing_comment_data` — Required comment fields are missing for the given action type
  - `not_allowed` — User is not enrolled in comment syncing
  - `invalid_sender_schema` — The sender field could not be transformed to a valid user schema

See https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/entity.acknowledgeCommentAction

Provide comments for work objects. Apps call this endpoint to send per-user flexpane comment data to the client.

Rate limit tier: 3

Method-specific errors (the `error` slug on the SlackError):
  - `method_not_found` — when the API isn't available to the caller
  - `invalid_trigger_id` — Trigger id is not valid
  - `invalid_app_id` — App ID is not a valid format
  - `invalid_auth` — Invalid token provided
  - `user_auth_url_missing` — User auth url is required if user_auth_required is true
  - `missing_delete_action_id` — delete_action_id is required when any comment is marked can_delete

See https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/entity.presentComments

Provide custom flexpane behavior for Work Objects. Apps call this endpoint to send per-user flexpane metadata to the client.

Rate limit tier: 3

Method-specific errors (the `error` slug on the SlackError):
  - `invalid_metadata` — The provided `metadata` argument could not be parsed or understood.
  - `feature_not_enabled` — temporarily gating API
  - `invalid_app_id` — App ID is not a valid format
  - `user_auth_url_missing` — User auth url is required if user_auth_required is true
  - `invalid_trigger_id` — Trigger id is not valid
  - `entity_metadata_does_not_match_trigger` — The provided entity's ID does not match the ID of the entity used to initiate the request
  - `missing_interactivity_url` — App does not have an interactivity URL configured
  - `missing_options_load_url` — App does not have an options load URL configured
  - `invalid_auth` — Invalid token provided

See https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/entity.presentDetails
